_purpose: The ONE reaction emoji palette (infinite-of-x). Consumed by native chat (src/reactions.rs, compile-time embedded), the relay's reaction allowlist (same module), and the web chat picker (fetched at runtime). Before 2026-07-24 these were three divergent hardcoded lists and the relay silently dropped most native reactions. Entries are stored in BARE form (no U+FE0F variation selector): the loader strips FE0F defensively, the relay normalizes incoming reactions the same way, and egui renders FE0F as tofu. Add a reaction by adding it to 'all' (and 'top' if it belongs on the quick row); native + relay pick it up on the next build, web on the next page load.
